example.title: Our Lady of Good Voyage Church, Gloucester (1915)

brief: The fishermen's church: a cream stucco Portuguese-style church with twin bell towers capped by blue domes, a statue of the Virgin holding a schooner between them, arched windows. Two photos. Older than 1970: the fishing-harbour church of this type is pre-war. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
